```{r}

# =============================================================================
# NEGATIVE ION MODE — INTEGRATION DELIVERABLES PREPARATION
# Run this AFTER completing EDA and statistical analysis
# Produces all files needed by the iRF and RGCCA integration team
#
# YOUR FILES NEEDED IN WORKING DIRECTORY:
#   polar_neg_pqn_imputed_glog.csv   — your main negative mode data
#   polar_pos_pqn_imputed_glog.csv   — positive mode (for shared sample IDs)
#   anova_negmode.csv                — downloaded from MetaboAnalyst ANOVA
#   sample_sheet.csv                 — experimental design
#   sig_features_neg_annotated.csv   — from your annotation script
# =============================================================================

# ── PACKAGES ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
needed <- c("ggplot2","dplyr","tidyr","tibble","ggrepel","pheatmap","viridis")
for (pkg in needed) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pkg)
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
  library(tibble); library(ggrepel); library(pheatmap); library(viridis)
})

BASE_DIR <- "."   # ← change to YOUR folder 
cat("Working directory:", getwd(), "\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# STEP 1: LOAD ALL DATA
# =============================================================================
cat("Loading data files...\n")

# Negative mode — your primary data
neg_raw  <- read.csv(file.path(BASE_DIR, "polar_neg_pqn_imputed_glog.csv"),
                     row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
mz_neg   <- neg_raw$mz
neg_mat  <- neg_raw[, colnames(neg_raw) != "mz"]

# Positive mode — only needed to identify shared samples
pos_raw  <- read.csv(file.path(BASE_DIR, "polar_pos_pqn_imputed_glog.csv"),
                     row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
pos_mat  <- pos_raw[, colnames(pos_raw) != "mz"]

# Sample sheet
ss <- read.csv(file.path(BASE_DIR, "sample_sheet.csv"),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(ss) <- c("sample_id", "concentration", "site", "description")
ss$concentration <- factor(ss$concentration, levels = c("Control","1x","10x"))
ss$site <- factor(ss$site,
                  levels = c("Control", paste0("D", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))))

# ANOVA results from MetaboAnalyst
anova_res <- read.csv(file.path(BASE_DIR, "anova_negmode.csv"),
                      row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
# Fix column names if needed
colnames(anova_res) <- trimws(colnames(anova_res))

# Annotated significant features (from your annotation script)
sig_annotated <- read.csv(file.path(BASE_DIR, "sig_features_neg_annotated.csv"),
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("✓ Negative mode: ", nrow(neg_mat), "features ×", ncol(neg_mat), "samples\n")
cat("✓ Positive mode: ", nrow(pos_mat), "features ×", ncol(pos_mat), "samples\n")
cat("✓ ANOVA results: ", nrow(anova_res), "features\n")
cat("✓ Annotated sig features: ", nrow(sig_annotated), "features\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# STEP 2: IDENTIFY SIGNIFICANT FEATURES
# Uses your MetaboAnalyst ANOVA results (FDR < 0.05)
# =============================================================================
cat("Extracting significant features...\n")

# Confirm FDR column name
fdr_col <- grep("FDR|fdr|adj", colnames(anova_res),
                ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
cat("  FDR column:", fdr_col, "\n")

sig <- anova_res[anova_res[[fdr_col]] < 0.05 &
                 !is.na(anova_res[[fdr_col]]), ]
cat("  Significant features (FDR<0.05):", nrow(sig), "\n")

# Get significant feature IDs
# These should directly match rownames of neg_mat
sig_ids <- rownames(sig)
sig_ids <- sig_ids[sig_ids %in% rownames(neg_mat)]
cat("  Matched back to neg_mat:", length(sig_ids), "\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# STEP 3: IDENTIFY SHARED SAMPLES (neg mode ∩ pos mode)
# The integration team needs the same samples in both modes
# Missing from neg mode: D06A2, D06B3, D07A3, D08B1, D10B4
# Missing from pos mode: D01B4 (and the above)
# Shared = only samples present in BOTH
# =============================================================================
cat("Identifying shared samples...\n")

neg_samples <- colnames(neg_mat)
pos_samples <- colnames(pos_mat)
shared_samples <- intersect(neg_samples, pos_samples)

# Also intersect with sample sheet to confirm
ss_samples <- ss$sample_id
shared_samples <- intersect(shared_samples, ss_samples)

cat("  Negative mode samples:", length(neg_samples), "\n")
cat("  Positive mode samples:", length(pos_samples), "\n")
cat("  Shared samples:       ", length(shared_samples), "\n")

# Samples in neg only (not in pos)
neg_only <- setdiff(neg_samples, pos_samples)
pos_only <- setdiff(pos_samples, neg_samples)
cat("  Neg mode only (exclude from integration):",
    paste(neg_only, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("  Pos mode only (exclude from integration):",
    paste(pos_only, collapse=", "), "\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# STEP 4: BUILD DELIVERABLE 1 — SIGNIFICANT FEATURES MATRIX
# sig_mat_neg_shared: 169 sig features × shared samples
# This is the PRIMARY deliverable for iRF and RGCCA
# =============================================================================
cat("Building significant features matrix...\n")

sig_mat_neg <- neg_mat[sig_ids, ]
sig_mat_neg_shared <- sig_mat_neg[, shared_samples]

cat("  Final matrix:", nrow(sig_mat_neg_shared),
    "features ×", ncol(sig_mat_neg_shared), "samples\n")

# Verify no missing values
n_na <- sum(is.na(sig_mat_neg_shared))
cat("  Missing values:", n_na, "(should be 0)\n\n")

# Save as CSV for integration team
write.csv(sig_mat_neg_shared,
          file.path(BASE_DIR, "sig_mat_neg_shared.csv"))
cat("✓ Saved: sig_mat_neg_shared.csv\n")
cat("  →", nrow(sig_mat_neg_shared), "significant features ×",
    ncol(sig_mat_neg_shared), "shared samples\n")
cat("  → Integration team loads this for iRF and RGCCA\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# STEP 5: BUILD DELIVERABLE 2 — PER-SITE SUMMARY
# How many features are significantly up/down at each site vs Control?
# Integration team uses this to cross-reference with RNA-seq site patterns
# =============================================================================
cat("Building per-site summary...\n")

# Parse metadata from sample names in neg_mat
decode_sample <- function(ids) {
  data.frame(
    sample_id     = ids,
    site          = ifelse(grepl("^CK", ids), "Control",
                           regmatches(ids, regexpr("D[0-9]{2}", ids))),
    concentration = ifelse(grepl("^CK", ids), "Control",
                    ifelse(grepl("A[0-9]$", ids), "1x", "10x")),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

meta_neg <- decode_sample(colnames(neg_mat))
meta_neg$site <- factor(meta_neg$site,
                         levels = c("Control",
                                    paste0("D", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))))
rownames(meta_neg) <- meta_neg$sample_id

# Control sample IDs
ctrl_ids <- meta_neg$sample_id[meta_neg$site == "Control"]

# For each site: t-test of significant features vs Control
# Fold change = mean(site) - mean(control) in glog space
site_list <- paste0("D", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))

site_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(site_list, function(s) {
  site_ids <- meta_neg$sample_id[meta_neg$site == s]
  site_ids <- site_ids[site_ids %in% colnames(sig_mat_neg)]
  
  if (length(site_ids) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      site = s, n_samples = length(site_ids),
      n_sig_vs_ctrl = NA, n_up = NA, n_down = NA
    ))
  }
  
  # Mean difference per feature (glog: subtraction = log ratio)
  fc <- rowMeans(sig_mat_neg[, site_ids, drop=FALSE]) -
        rowMeans(sig_mat_neg[, ctrl_ids, drop=FALSE])
  
  # T-test per feature, site vs control
  pvals <- sapply(rownames(sig_mat_neg), function(feat) {
    tryCatch(
      t.test(as.numeric(sig_mat_neg[feat, site_ids]),
             as.numeric(sig_mat_neg[feat, ctrl_ids]))$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
  })
  padj <- p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")
  
  # Threshold: FDR < 0.05 AND |FC| > 0.3 (meaningful change on glog scale)
  is_sig <- !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & abs(fc) > 0.3
  
  data.frame(
    site          = s,
    n_samples     = length(site_ids),
    n_sig_vs_ctrl = sum(is_sig),
    n_up          = sum(is_sig & fc > 0),
    n_down        = sum(is_sig & fc < 0)
  )
}))

cat("✓ Per-site summary:\n")
print(site_summary)

write.csv(site_summary,
          file.path(BASE_DIR, "site_significant_counts_neg.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n✓ Saved: site_significant_counts_neg.csv\n\n")

# PLOT: Per-site significant feature counts
p_site <- ggplot(site_summary %>% filter(!is.na(n_sig_vs_ctrl)),
                 aes(x = site)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = n_up), fill = "#D62728", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_col(aes(y = -n_down), fill = "#4575B4", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(y = n_up + 0.5, label = n_up),
            vjust = 0, size = 3, colour = "#D62728") +
  geom_text(aes(y = -n_down - 0.5, label = n_down),
            vjust = 1, size = 3, colour = "#4575B4") +
  labs(title    = "Significant metabolite changes per site vs Control",
       subtitle = "Red = elevated vs control; Blue = depleted vs control (neg ion mode)",
       x = "River site (upstream D01 → downstream D12)",
       y = "Number of significant features (FDR<0.05, |FC|>0.3)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(p_site)
ggsave(file.path(BASE_DIR, "fig_per_site_sig_counts_neg.pdf"),
       p_site, width = 10, height = 6)
cat("✓ Saved: fig_per_site_sig_counts_neg.pdf\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# STEP 6: SHARED SAMPLE METADATA — for integration team
# A clean metadata file for exactly the shared samples
# So iRF/RGCCA team knows site and concentration for each sample
# =============================================================================
cat("Building shared sample metadata...\n")

meta_shared <- decode_sample(shared_samples)
meta_shared <- merge(meta_shared,
                     ss[, c("sample_id","site","concentration","description")],
                     by = "sample_id", suffixes = c("_decoded","_sheet"))

# Use sample sheet version as ground truth
meta_shared$site_final <- meta_shared$site_sheet
meta_shared$conc_final <- meta_shared$concentration_sheet
meta_shared <- meta_shared[, c("sample_id","site_final","conc_final","description")]
colnames(meta_shared) <- c("sample_id","site","concentration","description")

# Order by site then concentration
meta_shared <- meta_shared %>%
  arrange(site, concentration)

write.csv(meta_shared,
          file.path(BASE_DIR, "shared_samples_metadata.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: shared_samples_metadata.csv\n")
cat("  →", nrow(meta_shared), "shared samples with site and concentration labels\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# STEP 7: SAVE R DATA OBJECT (equivalent of .RData for integration team)
# Contains everything they need in one loadable file
# =============================================================================
cat("Saving R data object...\n")

# This is the equivalent of your friend's metabolomics_complete.RData
neg_integration_data <- list(
  sig_mat_shared    = sig_mat_neg_shared,   # 169 features × shared samples
  full_mat          = neg_mat,              # 2331 features × 145 samples
  sig_feature_ids   = sig_ids,             # character vector of sig feature IDs
  metadata          = meta_shared,          # sample metadata for shared samples
  site_summary      = site_summary,         # per-site counts
  sig_annotated     = sig_annotated,        # annotated sig features
  shared_sample_ids = shared_samples,       # character vector of shared sample IDs
  anova_results     = anova_res            # full ANOVA table from MetaboAnalyst
)

save(neg_integration_data,
     file = file.path(BASE_DIR, "neg_metabolomics_integration.RData"))
cat("✓ Saved: neg_metabolomics_integration.RData\n")
cat("  → Integration team loads with: load('neg_metabolomics_integration.RData')\n")
cat("  → Access matrix with: neg_integration_data$sig_mat_shared\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# STEP 8: FINAL CHECKLIST
# =============================================================================
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
cat("DELIVERABLES READY FOR INTEGRATION TEAM\n")
cat("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

files_to_check <- c(
  "sig_mat_neg_shared.csv",
  "site_significant_counts_neg.csv",
  "fig_per_site_sig_counts_neg.pdf",
  "shared_samples_metadata.csv",
  "neg_metabolomics_integration.RData",
  "sig_features_neg_annotated.csv",
  "neg_sig_kegg_ids.txt",
  "neg_sig_hmdb_ids.txt",
  "neg_background_hmdb_ids.txt"
)

for (f in files_to_check) {
  exists <- file.exists(file.path(BASE_DIR, f))
  cat(ifelse(exists, "✓", "✗"), f,
      ifelse(exists, "", "  ← MISSING, check earlier scripts"), "\n")
}

cat("\n")
cat("MATRIX DIMENSIONS SUMMARY:\n")
cat("  sig_mat_neg_shared:", nrow(sig_mat_neg_shared), "features ×",
    ncol(sig_mat_neg_shared), "samples\n")
cat("  Shared sample IDs match pos mode: YES\n")
cat("  All values numeric: ", all(sapply(sig_mat_neg_shared, is.numeric)), "\n")
cat("  Missing values: ", sum(is.na(sig_mat_neg_shared)), "\n\n")

cat("TELL THE INTEGRATION TEAM:\n")
cat("─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat("1. Load data: load('neg_metabolomics_integration.RData')\n")
cat("   Matrix: neg_integration_data$sig_mat_shared\n")
cat("   Dimensions:", nrow(sig_mat_neg_shared), "×", ncol(sig_mat_neg_shared), "\n\n")
cat("2. Do NOT re-normalise — already PQN + glog processed\n\n")
cat("3. Shared samples:", length(shared_samples), "\n")
cat("   Excluded (neg only):", paste(neg_only, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("   Excluded (pos only):", paste(pos_only, collapse=", "), "\n\n")
cat("4. Key biology:\n")
cat("   - Site drives metabolic variation (not concentration)\n")
cat("   - Top pathway: amino sugar & nucleotide sugar metabolism FDR=0.0004\n")
cat("   - Convergent with pos mode: purine/nucleotide metabolism theme\n")
cat("   - Suggests structural disruption (chitin/exoskeleton) + oxidative stress\n")
cat("5. For iRF: use sig_mat_neg_shared as X matrix\n")
cat("            use site or concentration from metadata as Y\n")
cat("6. For RGCCA: use sig_mat_neg_shared as one block\n")
cat("              match on shared_sample_ids column order\n")



```
